ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle $ABCD$, $AB=8$. The rectangle is folded along the line $AC$, with point $B$ falling onto point $E$, and $AE$ intersects $CD$ at point $F$. If $AF=\frac{25}{4}$, what is the length of $AD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $DC\parallel AB$,\\
$\therefore \angle FCA=\angle CAB$, also $\angle FAC=\angle CAB$,\\
$\therefore \angle FAC=\angle FCA$,\\
$\therefore FA=FC=\frac{25}{4}$,\\
$\therefore FD=FE$,\\
Given $DC=AB=8$, $AF=\frac{25}{4}$,\\
$\therefore FD=FE=8-\frac{25}{4}=\frac{7}{4}$,\\
$\therefore AD=BC=EC=\sqrt{FC^{2}-FE^{2}}=\boxed{6}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, A is at the lower left, B is at the lower right, C is at the upper right, and D is at the upper left, representing rectangle ABCD; AB and BC are shown with dashed lines, and AC is the crease diagonal. Point E is located to the upper left of D, and line segment AE slants upward and intersects the horizontal CD at point F; point F is located between D and C, and E, F, A are collinear. EC is also drawn, indicating that B falls to E after being folded along AC, and C remains fixed on the crease. Reasoning: Because in the rectangle DC ∥ AB, and F, C, D are collinear, ∠FCA is equal to ∠CAB. The folding is carried out along AC, point B falls to E, and the crease AC maps ray AB to AE, so AC bisects ∠BAE, hence ∠FAC = ∠CAB. Thus ∠FAC = ∠FCA, triangle AFC is an isosceles triangle, obtaining FC = AF = 25/4. In the rectangle DC = AB = 8, and F is on DC, so FD = DC - FC = 8 - 25/4 = 7/4. Folding preserves length, A is fixed on the crease, and B is mapped to E, therefore AE = AB = 8. Also A, F, E are collinear, so FE = AE - AF = 8 - 25/4 = 7/4. Folding maps the right angle at B to the right angle at E, therefore AE ⟂ EC; since F is on AE, FE ⟂ EC. C is fixed on the crease AC, so EC = BC = AD. Therefore in right triangle FEC, FC is the hypotenuse, and FE is one leg: CE = sqrt(FC^2 - FE^2) = sqrt((25/4)^2 - (7/4)^2) = sqrt((625 - 49)/16) = sqrt(576/16) = sqrt(36) = 6. Therefore AD = CE = 6.
